note: free-exercise-db names muscle GROUPS (17 names in primaryMuscles/secondaryMuscles), not individual muscles or heads. A mapping row says only that the dataset's group name covers our muscle id; it is not evidence about any single muscle or head inside the group. Each justification rests on the dataset's own group name only. Dataset names with no seed muscle map to [].

abdominals.why: Group name for the abdominal muscles; rectus abdominis is our only abdominal seed muscle (the group also covers abdominals we do not track, e.g. obliques).

abductors.why: Hip abductor group; no seed muscle is a hip abductor by name.

adductors.why: Hip adductor group; no seed muscle is a hip adductor by name.

biceps.why: Arm group (dataset lists it with curls); biceps brachii. Hamstring exercises use the separate name 'hamstrings', so biceps femoris is not mapped here.

calves.why: Calf group; gastrocnemius and soleus are the seed calf muscles. The dataset does not say which of the two an exercise targets.

chest.why: Chest group; pectoralis major is our only chest seed muscle.

forearms.why: Forearm group; no seed muscle is in the forearm.

glutes.why: Gluteal group; gluteus maximus is our only gluteal seed muscle (the group also covers gluteus medius/minimus, which we do not track).

hamstrings.why: Hamstring group; the three seed hamstring muscles. The dataset does not distinguish between them.

lats.why: Common short name for latissimus dorsi.

lower back.why: Region name; no seed muscle is a lower-back muscle.

middle back.why: Region name that does not identify a muscle; left unmapped rather than guessed (could include part of trapezius, rhomboids and others).

neck.why: Region name; no seed muscle is a neck muscle.

quadriceps.why: Same group as our quadriceps_femoris id (four muscles treated as one seed id).

shoulders.why: Shoulder group; deltoid is our only shoulder seed muscle (the group may also cover rotator cuff muscles we do not track).

triceps.why: Common short name for triceps brachii.
